FArithmeticPhysical.both_tests_sourceScale_twosided_trace_net.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K))
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu]
  (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) (q : Fin 2) :
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let E :=
    DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  let rho := fun p => FAsymmetricCutoff.realMask K p.1.1 (p.1.2 ^ 2) (LCutoffRegime.sharedSmoothing p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2);
  have M := fun p => KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (rho p) ⋯ ⋯;
  ∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
    Tendsto (fun p => Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((M p).comp ((E T).starProjection.comp (A.comp (M p)))))
        LCutoffRegime.localRegime (𝓝 (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A))) ∧
      Tendsto
        (fun p =>
          ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
            ↑(rho p x) *
                DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A (fun x y => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (x * y⁻¹)) x x *
              ↑(rho p x) ∂mu)
        LCutoffRegime.localRegime (𝓝 (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A)))

FOrbitalPhysical.both_tests_twosided_originalHaar_orbital_limit.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)) [lambda.IsHaarMeasure]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) (q : Fin 2) :
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let E :=
    DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0 (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have rho := fun p => FSmoothCutoff.mask K p.1 (p.2 / p.1);
  have M := fun p => KPhysicalMask.realMaskCLM mu (FSmoothCutoff.realMask K p.1 (p.2 / p.1)) ⋯ ⋯;
  have c := (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda).haarScalarFactor mu;
  have k := fun T p x y =>
    rho p x * DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A (fun x y => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (x * y⁻¹)) x y *
      rho p y;
  have orbit := fun T p j x =>
    ↑(∑' (t : Kˣ),
          NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * x) *
            NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K
              ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) j⁻¹ * x))) *
      k T p ↑((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) j⁻¹ * x) ↑x;
  0 < c ∧
    ∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
          Integrable (fun x => ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x) * ∑' (j : Kˣ), orbit T p j x) lambda ∧
            Integrable (fun x => NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x * ∑' (j : Kˣ), ‖orbit T p j x‖) lambda ∧
              ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
                  ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x) * ∑' (j : Kˣ), orbit T p j x ∂lambda =
                -(↑↑c * Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((M p).comp ((E T).starProjection.comp (A.comp (M p)))))) ∧
        Tendsto
          (fun p =>
            ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
              ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x) * ∑' (j : Kˣ), orbit T p j x ∂lambda)
          FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime (𝓝 (-(↑↑c * Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A))))
